promptText: Use case: precise-object-edit. Repair one native 1254 x 1254 hand-painted game terrain patch. Image 1 is the current patch to repair. Image 2 is its exact approved coordinate-layout guide; the guide is blurred but its land-water geometry is authoritative. Image 3 is a REFERENCE-ONLY panel with two horizontal strips: its UPPER half (1254 x 230 pixels) is the NORTH overlap for the top 230 rows of the output; its LOWER half is the SOUTH overlap for the bottom 230 rows of the output. Do not copy the panel seam into the output. Image 4 is the WEST 230-pixel strip, image 5 is the EAST 230-pixel strip. Preserve their native pixel scale along the corresponding edges. Main correction: REMOVE the erroneous dry golden-sand peninsula/crescent in image 1 from the lower-left quadrant (roughly x=0..470,y=790..1254). Replace that entire protrusion with continuous TRANSLUCENT shallow turquoise/cream water and delicate irregular white foam, flowing into the existing lower/right sea. The broad pale cream areas in image 2 are shallow water with thin foam, NOT exposed dry sand. The only true dry beach is at the UPPER LEFT, with one continuous gently curving shoreline exiting left around y=550 and top/right upper area according to the north and east strips. Avoid the unnatural inlet split at top-middle seen in image 1: preserve a continuous connected top beach and match the native north strip. At the whole bottom edge, match the LOWER half of image 3 water exactly: pale luminous water at left gradually cyan to the right, with native foam and caustic details; absolutely no exposed golden sand or pebbles below y=760. Preserve water hue, wave scale, diffuse daylight and refined Q Daoist hand-painted style. Preserve correct portions of image 1 and all four neighboring surface transitions as much as possible. No added rocks, land, islands, architecture, plants, characters, text, grid or border. Crisp original native 1254x1254 pixels, no enlargement of the guide, no montage.
